messages:
alex: Heads-up — audit found ~120 DB snapshots in the archive bucket that lack the `x-amz-server-side-encryption` metadata. Looks like backups from last night missed SSE headers after the agent deploy.
priya: ugh. which agent deploy? the backup-uploader v2 change earlier today?
ben: I saw the deploy at 04:12 UTC that swapped uploader -> multipart gzip preprocessor. Could be stripping custom headers during upload.
marta: Any restores failing atm? or just metadata missing?
alex: Restores for one tenant failed with `KMSInvalidCiphertextException` when we tried to decrypt in staging. Other restores still ok. Error correlates to objects that went through the new preprocessor.
priya: can you paste the exact error and example object key?
alex: Error: `An error occurred (KMSInvalidCiphertextException) when calling the Decrypt operation` — object key `snapshots/customer-42/2026-02-26/part-0003.gz`.
ben: quick check: the uploader sets SSE-C or SSE-KMS? our pipeline normally uses SSE-KMS with cmk tag `x-redwood-cmek-id` on the S3 object metadata.
marta: if metadata got removed the s3->kms decrypt call won't find the associated CMK info and may fail if encryption was client-side or SSE-C. For SSE-KMS the KMS context sometimes preserved only as object metadata by the uploader.
alex: I ran `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-archive --key "snapshots/customer-42/2026-02-26/part-0003.gz"` and saw no `Metadata` field besides `original-filename`. No `x-redwood-cmek-id`.
priya: encops-bot, create incident and link to deploy? :alarm_clock:
encops-bot: incident created INC-2026-0423. Triage channel: #inc-INC-2026-0423. Tags: encryption, backups, uploader-agent.
ben: immediate mitigation: revert uploader preprocessor to previous tagless behavior and re-run upload for the affected snapshot set from staging copy. I'll prepare a rollback PR.
marta: Also need an RBAC check: did the SA used by uploader lose kms:Decrypt/grant on the CMK during the role rename earlier this week? That could explain some decrypt attempts failing differently.
alex: I queried CloudTrail for `kms:Decrypt` failures for that SA between 03:00-06:00 UTC — 7 failures matching the same object keys.
priya: good catch. So two simultaneous causes: metadata-stripping preprocessor + role rename reduced grants. Combined effect produced decrypt failures.
ben: Plan: 1) roll back preprocessor (in progress), 2) reapply CMK grants to uploader SA (marta to confirm), 3) reupload affected parts (ben will run a script to copy from local staging copies), 4) run end-to-end restore smoke and mark incident resolved.
marta: I'll reapply grants. KMS grant command I plan to run:

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-backups --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/backup-uploader --operations Decrypt,Encrypt --name grant-backup-uploader
```

marta: also adding an audit event check to detect any future uploads where `Metadata` does not contain `x-redwood-cmek-id`.
priya: add a log-based alert in logging pipeline to fire if any `head-object` shows missing cmek metadata for new uploads.
alex: ben, after rollback can you run this local check to enumerate affected objects:

```
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-archive --prefix "snapshots/" --query "Contents[?contains(Key, '2026-02-26')].Key"
# then for each key: aws s3api head-object --bucket ... --key "{key}" | jq .Metadata
```

ben: yup I'll run and produce a short CSV of keys missing cmek id and push to the incident thread.
oncall: I'm standing by to coordinate restores if we need an emergency rollback of tenant data.
priya: secure next steps: - patch uploader to preserve all `x-amz-meta-*` headers during gzip preproc - add integration test that uploads+heads objects checking metadata - add an encops playbook note about SA renames and necessary KMS grant reconciliation.
alex: timeline: rollback in 10m, reapply grants in 30m, reupload/retest in 90m. I'll update INC-2026-0423 with status.
encops-bot: update: rollback PR merged by ben at 1708854590. Monitoring for decrypt errors.
ben: pushed CSV to incident: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0423/missing-cmek-keys.csv
marta: grant reapply complete at 1708854642. KMS audit shows successful Decrypts starting at 1708854660.
priya: once incident is closed, follow-up tickets: BACKUP-421 (uploader integration test), SEC-882 (audit alert for missing cmek metadata), OP-337 (playbook update).
alex: thanks everyone. quick postmortem to follow in #postmortems but short notes: root cause = uploader gzip preprocessor stripped object metadata; contributing cause = role rename earlier this week removed a transient grant. :white_check_mark:
